Download all synapse positions from the annotation service

octo_synapse_positions.Rd

Works without materialization: returns positions only (no root IDs). Downloads in resumable chunks (CSV files in outdir); run again after an interruption to continue.

Usage

octo_synapse_positions(
  table = "synapses_v8",
  start = 1L,
  stop = NULL,
  outdir = paste0(table, "_chunks"),
  chunk = 100000L,
  valid_only = TRUE
)

Arguments

table

annotation table

start, stop

range of annotation IDs (default: all)

outdir

folder for the chunk files

chunk

annotation IDs per chunk file

valid_only

drop rows with valid == FALSE

Value

data.table with id, score, valid and position columns (nm)
